title: Intrinsic finite pullback tensor normalization on K-flat complexes
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, a scheme morphism f:X -> Y with ell invertible on X and Y, and n >= 0. Let F be the intrinsic finite pullback at the prescribed level n and LF its exact derived functor, with canonical tensor comparison mu from [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction]. For K-flat cochain complexes P,Q of normalized finite coefficient module sheaves on Y whose termwise pullbacks FP,FQ are K-flat, there is a chain isomorphism k:F Tot(P tensor Q) ~= Tot(FP tensor FQ). Define FinitePullbackTensorGenerators by requiring, for each bidegree (p,q), p+q=i, site object U and sections x,y, that k in degree i sends the inverse-image adjunction unit of the sheafified total tensor generator x tensor y to the total generator of the two inverse-image unit sections over baseChange_f U. This equation holds for k. Moreover LF(s_Y(P,Q));mu(QP,QQ);T_X(factors_P,factors_Q) = factors_Tot;Q_X(k);s_X(FP,FQ), where s_Y and s_X are exactly coefficientFiniteTensorModelIso for the chosen pullbackTensorCalculus. No quotient, coefficient-change comparison, boundedness, or flatness of terms is assumed.

proof.text: Take the direct-sum total of the normalized ordinary tensor pullback isomorphism, conjugated by the unit-normalized finite realization. Its generator formula is precisely FinitePullbackTensorGenerators. The total differential signs agree on every bidegree.

On flat-term K-flat pairs the defining representative square of proEtaleCanonicalTensorPullback, transported through the finite realization and finite tensor model comparisons, gives the displayed equality.

For arbitrary K-flat inputs choose flat-term K-flat resolutions. Exact pullback and tensoring K-flat complexes preserve the resulting quasi-isomorphisms. Naturality of the ordinary total comparison and both prescribed tensor models transports the equality along their invertible localizations.

theorem finitePullbackTensor_kflat_normalization {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] (n : ℕ)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P)
    (hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) Q)
    (hFP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
      (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (hFQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
      (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) :
    ∃ k : ((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology Y)
            (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)).obj (P, Q)) ≅
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)).obj
          (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj P,
           ((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
             (.up ℤ)).obj Q),
      FinitePullbackTensorGenerators l E f n P Q k ∧
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
          (coefficientFiniteTensorModelIso l E Y
            (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors n P Q hP hQ).hom ≫
        ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)).hom ≫
        (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map
          (Prod.mkHom
            ((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))
              f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P)
            ((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))
              f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q)) =
      (sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))
        f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app _ ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map k.hom ≫
        (coefficientFiniteTensorModelIso l E X
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
          n _ _ hFP hFQ).hom
